summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K on July 17, 2026, reporting an amendment to its Amended and Restated Supply Agreement dated July 7, 2026. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, disclosing a contractual amendment to an existing supply arrangement. No terms of the amendment, such as price per share, premium, or valuation, are provided. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are mentioned. This is a standard operational update, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing does not indicate any catalyst or risk-arb event.
